name: Shatterfall
description: Shards blast outward with knockback; struck enemies Exposed

name: Thunderclap
description: The target becomes a lightning rod, arcing to 4 enemies and electrifying water within 4 m

name: Coup de Grace
description: The hit always crits; executes non-elites under 20% and elites under 8%

name: Sundering Judgment
description: Ignores 50% of armour; nearby enemies knocked down

name: Groundbreaker
description: Rooted enemies are torn up and launched for a 1.2 s juggle; landing deals area damage

name: Sacred Bloom
description: Holy flowers burst; allies within 5 m gain a barrier of 10% max health

name: Hex Bloom
description: Enemies within 6 m take 20% more damage for 5 s

name: Chain Execution
description: The strike jumps through every Shocked enemy within 8 m at 60% damage each

name: Thunderbloom
description: Lightning runs along the roots between rooted enemies; the roots become electrified briars for 4 s

name: Frostbriar
description: A frost-thorn field slows and damages enemies; heroes inside regenerate 2% health a second

name: Feeding Frenzy
description: The spirit wolf devours the poison, dealing it at once x1.5; both heroes heal 30% of it, capped at 15% max health

name: Thornhunt
description: The target and rooted enemies within 6 m bleed heavily for 3 s; crits refresh it

name: Twin Verdict
description: Triple stagger; Sanctified ground nearby fuses into a holy nova

name: Superconduct
description: Enemies within 5 m take 30% more elemental damage for 6 s

name: Crimson Waltz
description: Every bleed and poison on the target detonates; a kill gives both heroes 3 Momentum

name: Wild Hunt
description: A spirit stampede charges through rooted enemies in a line
